old: a WeChat account able to pay CNY 1 through WeChat Pay. The vendor's own documentation states the check is not a real-name system, that it works because WeChat Pay requires a bank card and real-name information bound to the wallet, that SimpFun stores no real-name information, and that a phone-number binding was rejected as a privacy collection. Nothing read states whether a wallet without a mainland bank card can pay, so that part is unverified.
new: a WeChat account able to pay CNY 1 in the vendor's WeChat mini-programme. The vendor's own documentation states the check is not a real-name system, that it works because WeChat Pay requires a bank card and real-name information bound to the wallet, that SimpFun stores no real-name information, and that a phone-number binding was rejected as a privacy collection. WeChat Pay's own documentation lets an unverified overseas phone number bind an international card and pay without uploading an identity document, up to CNY 3,000 a transaction, and accepts a passport for a verified wallet, so a wallet without mainland real-name can pay the CNY 1. SimpFun states no rule on international cards, and WeChat Pay notes that some merchants do not accept them, so that part is unverified. The nearest kind is card; the true one is a wallet-payment kind, which the vocabulary lacks.
